newsitems.title: ESL Pro League Finals + Season 2 Reveal
newsitems.author: [UBI]Epi
newsitems.contents:
[IMG]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/rainbow6/siege/PAXEHeader_246689.jpg[/IMG]

It has been a long road since IEM Katowice, and the kick off of the Rainbow Six Pro League. The season has been filled with upsets, aces, and incredible new strategies employed by these elite teams. Despite the close matches throughout Season One, two teams from each region have risen to the top and earned their spot in the season one finals.

The Xbox One season one finals of the Rainbow Six Pro League will be hosted at PAX East on April 22nd, and we invite you to join us at the ESL Main Stage. The event will start as soon as the doors open at 10:00am EDT. Should you be unable to attend in person, the entire event will be broadcasted live on the official Rainbow Six Twitch channel, starting at 9:30AM EDT.

In addition to these awesome matches, we will be having a special Season 2 reveal as well. Tune in to get the latest info!
Read more here: [url]http://ubi.li/e5gz7[/url]

Follow the [URL=www.twitch.tv/Rainbow6]Official Twitch Channel[/URL] to be notified when we go live!

newsitems.title: Xbox One Pro League will be at PAX East 2016
newsitems.author: ItsEpi
newsitems.contents:
[IMG]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/rainbow6/siege/PAXEHeader_246689.jpg[/IMG]

It has been a long road since IEM Katowice, and the kick off of the Rainbow Six Pro League. The season has been filled with upsets, aces, and incredible new strategies employed by these elite teams. Despite the close matches throughout Season One, two teams from each region have risen to the top and earned their spot in the season one finals.

The Xbox One season one finals of the Rainbow Six Pro League will be hosted at PAX East on April 22nd, and we invite you to join us at the ESL Main Stage. The event will start as soon as the doors open at 10:00am EDT. Should you be unable to attend in person, the entire event will be broadcasted live on the official Rainbow Six Twitch channel, starting at 9:30AM EDT.

Read more here: [url]http://ubi.li/e5gz7[/url]
